title: EDG Community Update: Week of August 15th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- Edgeware ecosystem now has a [new website domain](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1559623326573953024): edgeware.io
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects can upgrade their nodes to the [pre-release v3.5.1](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.5.1) to be prepared in advance for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade's on-chain democracy proposal.
- Upcoming Activities/Events: [Kabocha’s Technical AMA ft. Ramsey and Rusty Crewmates](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1561790334035714048), The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns (ongoing), Kabocha’s Community Mods Onboarding Quiz

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- [OnFinality introduced new functionalities](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FIeWmAcGSFrMxKw1jsKq-ExPxDX5mvMd/view?usp=sharing) like API rate limits, premium high usage paid plan for protocols/users and budget estimation features.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-aug-14/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcomed to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink's oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)'s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
